title: HGR-* items
summary: Internal hub gears under the HGR item family, covering stock levels for HGR-5S and HGR-8S at WH-MAN-STR.
body:
The HGR item family covers internal hub gears stocked by Northbridge Cycles. As of 09:00 on 26 October 2026, stock records track inventory positions for 5-speed and 8-speed hub assemblies at the main store warehouse WH-MAN-STR. Current balances show available inventory for production alongside pending allocations.

| Item code | Description | Warehouse | On hand | Allocated | On order |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HGR-5S | Hub gear 5-speed | WH-MAN-STR | 21 | 0 | 0 |
| HGR-8S | Hub gear 8-speed | WH-MAN-STR | 36 | 2 | 0 |

## Stock on hand

At 09:00 on 26 October 2026, stock for hub gear HGR-5S at WH-MAN-STR was 21 on hand, 0 allocated, and 0 on order [^r1]. At the same time, stock for hub gear HGR-8S at WH-MAN-STR was 36 on hand, 2 allocated, and 0 on order [^r2]. Full inventory balances across all part numbers are catalogued in [[data-stock-on-hand|Stock_on_hand_2026-10-26_0900]].
